name: Balnir Farmstead
summary: The Balnir Farmstead is a derelict estate in eastern Tirisfal Glades, northeast of the Ruins of Lordaeron. Once a working farm of the Balnir family, the lands now lie ruined and infested by wandering Scourge that slip past the Bulwark.

sections.title: A Farm Before the Plague
sections.body: For generations, the Balnir family worked their homestead in the rolling hills of eastern Tirisfal, and their garden of snapdragons still blooms among the ruins. When the Scourge swept through Lordaeron during the Third War, the farm was overrun and its people lost, leaving the buildings to rot.

sections.title: Desolation and Scourge Infiltration
sections.body: In the wake of the Third War, the ruins serve as a foothold for mindless Scourge slipping past the Bulwark. Forsaken deathguards watch the farm warily, while Undercity magi harvest surviving snapdragons from the garden to test how deeply plague corruption has crept into the soil.

faq.q: Why is the Balnir Farmstead important?
faq.answer: It sits on the eastern approaches to Tirisfal, just behind the Bulwark. Scourge that slip past the defenders gather here, and its garden of snapdragons lets the Forsaken mages measure how far the plague has spread into Tirisfal.

faq.q: Who lived at the farmstead before the plague?
faq.answer: The farm belonged to the Balnir family, who gave it their name. They were lost when the Scourge swept through Tirisfal during the Third War, and today only the undead walk its fields.

faq.q: Why are the Forsaken monitoring the farm now?
faq.answer: Mindless Scourge often slip past the Bulwark from the Plaguelands and gather at the farmstead, threatening the eastern approaches to Tirisfal. Additionally, Undercity scholars study the resilient snapdragons still growing in the gardens to measure the spread of plague contamination.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, the farmstead is a bitter reminder of the Lordaeron they lost, as well as a nagging security breach where Scourge from the Plaguelands slip behind the Bulwark.
Forsaken magi are dispatched to these blighted grounds to gather surviving Balnir snapdragons, studying them to detect the lingering magical taint of the Scourge.
